debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

debt.method: debt holding probability = clamp(0.15 + private credit / 300, 0.05, 0.85); debt = income × clamp(private credit / 100, 0, 2) × uniform(0.1, 1.0) when held. Private credit determines a bounded holding probability and an income-scaled debt amount because household debt microdata are absent.

expenses.method: expenses = max(0, coalesce(household consumption PPP, GNI PPP × (1 - clamp(savings rate, -25, 50) / 100)) × uniform(0.8, 1.2)). Expenses vary uniformly from 0.8 to 1.2 of the macro base. When household consumption is unavailable, expenses use GNI less a savings rate clamped from -25 to 50 percent.

income.method: income = max(0, GNI PPP × selected quintile share / 20 × uniform(0.7, 1.3)). Each equal-population income quintile has probability 0.2 for a synthetic agent because WDI supplies quintile shares, not microdata. Income varies uniformly from 0.7 to 1.3 of the selected quintile mean.

money.method: money = annual expenses × uniform(1, 12) / 52. Liquid money spans a uniform one to twelve weeks of expenses.

prices.method: WDI PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate; a relative national price-level estimate rather than a household basket.

savings.method: savings = income × max(0, adjusted net savings rate) / 100 × uniform(0.5, 1.5). A macro adjusted-net-savings flow proxies one year of person-level savings stock with a uniform 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier.

traits.finance_default_reason: Person-level finance is imputed from this country's WDI PPP income shares and macro finance observations; linked household microdata is absent.
